answer: Witnessed Uptime Sampling. Each identity is assigned a fixed umber challenge slot and must return a signed heartbeat within a narrow window; missed or duplicated responses are rejected. Agents are scored at every terrace of the schedule, and only consistent responders accumulate routing priority, so a clone born today starts near the vertex of the queue and earns nothing for weeks. A cloner must run full infrastructure per identity through that dead interval, paying compute and latency costs no revenue offsets, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
